summary: Iteration 21 - MQTT Integration feature testing completed. All backend tests (18/18) PASSED. Frontend tests all PASSED. New MQTT feature is fully functional.

mqtt_config_get_default.test: GET /api/mqtt/config returns default config when no config exists
mqtt_config_get_default.result: Returns default config with expected fields (enabled, broker_url, broker_port, etc.)

mqtt_config_save.result: Successfully saves broker_url, port, username, password, use_tls, subscribe_topics

mqtt_password_masked.result: Password returned as '********' with password_set=true when password exists

mqtt_status.result: Returns enabled, connected, connection_status, connection_message fields

mqtt_test_connection.result: Endpoint exists and returns success/message result

mqtt_mappings_list.test: GET /api/mqtt/mappings returns list of gateway mappings
mqtt_mappings_list.result: Returns array with existing mapping (DSE Gateway Test)

mqtt_mappings_create.result: Successfully creates mapping with gateway_name, topic_prefix, generator_id

mqtt_mappings_delete.result: Successfully deletes mapping and removes from list

non_admin_access_denied.test: Non-admin users get 403 on all MQTT endpoints
non_admin_access_denied.result: All 7 MQTT endpoints correctly return 403 for non-admin (mitarbeiter) user

frontend_mqtt_link_button.test: Admin page has MQTT link button in header
frontend_mqtt_link_button.result: MQTT button visible and navigates to /mqtt-config

frontend_mqtt_config_page.test: MQTT Config page renders with all sections
frontend_mqtt_config_page.result: All sections present: Broker-Konfiguration, Gateway-Zuordnungen, Gateway Einrichtung, Roh-Nachrichten

frontend_mqtt_form_elements.test: All form elements present and functional
frontend_mqtt_form_elements.result: All inputs found: enabled switch, broker_url, port, username, password, topics, TLS toggle, save/test buttons

frontend_mqtt_mapping_form.result: Inputs fillable, generator dropdown shows available generators

frontend_mqtt_navigation.test: Back button navigates to Admin page

seed_data_creation: Test gateway mappings created and cleaned up during testing
